header: The ask, with the objections answered right beside it
lead: Badge, heading, one button and a quieter link, over a row of reassurances. Three is the ceiling — a fourth stops sounding like confidence and starts sounding like anxiety.
note: Signing up happens on the target page. This band never renders a field, so nothing here collects, stores or sends anything.

reassurances.title: One objection each
reassurances.text: An icon, a title and a sentence — the same unit the whole catalog repeats.

reassurances.title: Beside the button
reassurances.text: An objection answered after the decision has been taken is not an answer.

reassurances.title: Zero to four
reassurances.text: Leave the collection empty and the band is a plain ask with nothing missing.
